title: MOS momentum z>1 leads MOS returns 2d
hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] MOS close 20d z-score > 1 leads MOS log returns by 2 days (+) as fertilizer momentum persists rather than mean-reverts (reversal of R2-0056 short rule); trade long MOS 3d [finance.MOS.close -> finance.MOS.log_return] (parent: R2-0056)

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.MOS.close rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long MOS next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fertilizer-ag] MOS close 20d z-score > 1 leads NTR log returns by 2 days (+) as potash momentum spills over to a peer fertilizer name, avoiding the same-series degeneracy of R2-0157 (lag-0 r=1.0); trade long NTR 3d [finance.MOS.close -> finance.NTR.log_return] (parent: R2-0157)
